name: The Lost Heaven
summary: The Lost Heaven is a narrative-driven, post-apocalyptic sci-fi action-adventure game. You will play the role of a failed interstellar immigrant trying to survive on a world on the verge of collapse, find your ideal machine companion, embark on an unexpected journey, and uncover the truth behind the "doomsday" together.
